correctness.rationale: The source fast SGD block on f=lambda*x^2/2 gives q=(1-s)^tau, s=gamma*lambda. Eliminate the source slow buffer from u_{t+1}=beta u_t+(1-q)x_t/gamma and x_{t+1}=x_t-alpha*gamma u_{t+1}; the exact recurrence is x_{t+1}=[1+beta-alpha(1-q)]x_t-beta*x_{t-1}. For 0<=beta<1 the three quadratic Jury inequalities reduce exactly to 0<alpha(1-q)<2(1+beta). For alpha=1, even tau gives 0<s<2, odd tau gives 0<s<1+(1+2beta)^(1/tau), the latter strictly beyond 2 iff beta>0. At s=2 even tau root is +1; at odd upper boundary root is -1. Independently computed eigenvalues for (tau,beta,s)=(3,0.5,2.2), stable complex modulus sqrt(.5), and (2,.5,2.2), unstable root 1.634; analytic Jury, not sampling, establishes all tau.
